import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));

import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()

 s=o if isinstance(o,str) else json.dumps(o,indent=2)

ids=[str(i) for i in json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']]
w('access-inventory.json',{'global_get_hops':len(attempts),'maximum':48,'per_id':{i:sum(i in x['routes'] for x in attempts) for i in ids},'per_id_maximum':12,'outcomes':records,'unavailable':failures,'network_quarantine':False,'protocol_fail':False,'inherited_denials':'Binding worldwide; none attempted; no alternate-delivery failures retried','registry_roots_charged_all20':True})

 q=p/f'sources/{n}.pdf';source.append({'file':str(q.relative_to(p)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'read_depth':depth,'figures':'Not visually reviewed; no material figure used in asserted proofs','text':f'sources/{n}.txt'})

receipts=[]
for q in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(q.read_text());receipts.append({'file':q.name,'exit':o['exit'],'killed':o['killed'],'wall_s':o['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':o['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':o['child_cpu_cumulative_s']})
w('resource-inventory.json',{'completed_runner_receipts_at_snapshot':receipts,'caps':'affinity<=2; childCPU115; supervisorCPU120; AS6GiB; sampled group RSS6GiB; deadline130; outer140; arena2','unavailable':'Native search CPU/RSS, transient process peaks, separate writer RSS','synchronous_reaping':'All run.py subprocesses completed synchronously and tools report exit. No background jobs started.','bootstrap_receipt':'bootstrap-receipt.json original preserved','before':'frozen-before.json','terminal_receipts':'This inventory predates inventories_and_handoff_check receipt; final SHA manifest includes it and all later completed receipts, excluding only named final manifest generation artifacts.'})
prov=json.loads((p/'provenance-complete.json').read_text());assert len(prov)==20 and all(e['newline'] and e['raw_statement_token_sha256'] for e in prov)
for e in prov:assert hashlib.sha256((p/f"corpus/{e['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e['raw_line_sha256']
g=json.loads((p/'keyed-gates.json').read_text());assert set(g)==set(ids)
for v in g.values():assert all(k in v for k in ['literal_gate','source_gate','math_gate','prior_gate','novelty_gate','significance_gate','formal_gate','independent_gate','acceptance_gate'])
assert json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text())['calls_used']==3
